title: Drill Navigation
description: Click-to-drill decision logic independent of React.
body: Click-to-drill (PRD §17 Wave 5). Pure and DOM-free: the decision of where a click leads lives here, unit-tested, and `SchematicCanvas.tsx` only turns a click into a call to it. Breadcrumb walk-up depends on navigation history, not document state, so it stays as `App.tsx`'s own small piece of React state instead.
